mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_flow_log ( ticket_id, operator_id, operation_type, operation_desc, before_status, after_status, before_assignee_id, after_assignee_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{ticketId}, #{operatorId}, #{operationType}, #{operationDesc}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{beforeAssigneeId}, #{afterAssigneeId}, NOW() )
mapper.sql: SELECT l.*, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM ticket_flow_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.operator_id
mapper.select: WHERE l.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY l.create_time ASC, l.id ASC
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC
WHERE l.operator_id = #{operatorId} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT create_time FROM ticket_flow_log WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND after_status = #{status} AND (before_status IS NULL OR before_status != after_status) ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
